verdicts.claim: the whole four-organ genome, sealed, is at most 512 bytes
all five germinations, the seal check included, make no network call
on the reference data every organ reproduces seed-library’s sealed held-out AUC exactly, and answers every held case at exactly the accuracy the ribosome grades
verdicts.saw: shopper 0.815265 = sealed, triage 0.952127 = sealed, water 0.747656 = sealed, crop 0.753796 = sealed; every held case answered at the graded accuracy

verdicts.claim: every one-character change to the genome is refused; the maker’s key swapped is refused on the signature; another maker’s trust list refuses it
verdicts.saw: 486/486 one-character changes refused; maker swapped → signature; another maker trusted → untrusted maker

verdicts.claim: the rules it grows are at least twice the bytes the genome carries: the device’s data supplies the rest
verdicts.saw: grows 1196 bytes of rules from 496 carried (×2.41129)

verdicts.claim: on device-a and device-b, each holding half the history, all four organs still clear the gate, each within 0.03 AUC of the reference, and the three organisms all differ
germination is deterministic: three more runs grow the reference organism’s id, and CI re-derives the record byte for byte
with the shopper labels shuffled the shopper organ scores a coin (held-out AUC from 0.45 to 0.55), is cut, and abstains on every shopper case, while the other three organs answer every case
verdicts.saw: shopper cut at AUC 0.513084, 4725/4725 abstained; triage 720/720 answered, water 720/720 answered, crop 720/720 answered

verdicts.claim: with no water data the water organ is dormant and abstains on every water case; the other three are live and answer every case
verdicts.saw: water dormant, 720/720 abstained; shopper 4725/4725, triage 720/720, crop 720/720 answered
